pr_title: Remove assignments to Child/Children in OsuClickableContainer subclasses
pr_body:
Fixes #21676
There may still be some instances where `Clear()` is called on `OsuClickableContainer` from assigning to `Child` or `Children`, but I removed as many as I could find.
pr_comments: Please check code inspection and test failures.

I disagree with this on a conceptual level. `Clear` should never be disabled for a reason like this.

Needs a different solution.

issue_context.title: `LeaderboardScore` and some other `OsuClickableContainer`s do not have hover (click) sounds
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

Regressed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/21619.

That PR made hover sounds possible to be removed when using `Child`/`Children` in `load()`/`LoadComplete()`. Not sure of a good solution other than:
- Replacing those with `Add()`/`AddRange()` and restricting `Child`/`Children` somehow
- Moving `CreateHoverSounds()` to `LoadComplete()` and hope there's no `Child`/`Children` calls after

### Screenshots or videos

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/208231081-eb73a1ff-6662-4bb9-bcfe-a510ade9db3e.mp4

### Version

master

### Logs

N/A
comments: May be make a private class in `OsuClickableContainer` which will hold hover sounds as an internal drawable and make that a content instead? Should repair this case and leave everything working in mentioned pr, but that'd be too many containers probably: this new container having sounds and another container for content and it's everything in `OsuClickableContainer`
Yeah I was thinking something along those lines too but that does seem to be getting close to too much overhead.
I'd fix the cases and throw on `AddInternal` / `AddRangeInternal` if that's ample to solve this. More containers sounds bad

It's not an `Internal` problem. Since we are adding `HoverSounds` to the content container - any setting/clearing children in sub-classes will remove the sounds. So I guess throwing on `Clear()` and `Children.set` then?
pretty sure those call `AddInternal` themselves, but yeah, that's the direction I was thinking.
Is it alright if @RaafatSalib and I look into fixing this issue? Do you have any further suggestions before we get started?

Yep, that is what the `good-first-issue` label is for. I recommend reading the [Submitting pull requests](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#submitting-pull-requests) section of the contributing guidelines first, and don't hesitate to ask questions in the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/ppy) (or here until you are verified).

I might be overlooking something obvious with this, but why can't the `HoverSounds` be added as an `Internal` component of `OsuClickableContainer` rather than as a direct child? From what I can tell, this prevents the sounds from being removed in any sub-classes.
Everything is in a hierarchy. That's how osu!framework works.

> why can't the `HoverSounds` be added as an `Internal` component of `OsuClickableContainer` rather than as a direct child?

That would be a partial revert of the PR mentioned in the OP. Does that not regress the issue that PR was fixing?

It doesn't appear to bring back the original issue of buttons receiving input outside the content. Although, I don't know the details of exactly how to reproduce the original issue, keeping the `HoverSounds` as `Internal` still passes the test created in the PR mentioned.

The test mentioned doesn't test audio playback because testing that is pretty much not feasible as we have things structured.

Also I've checked, and changing back to `AddInternal()` would regress the fix. See following video:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20418176/214396008-b4d65d19-08e8-4ccc-a546-0e2035393f80.mp4

Notice how I can get the hover sound to play even though the mouse is not inside the bounds of the actual button part of the pink sheared "back" button yet.

From your previous discussion about this issue, it seems that the best solution at the moment is to throw on `Clear()` in the `OsuClickableContainer` component, and then in all `OsuClickableContainer` subclasses, we change all instances of `Child = ...`  or `Children = new Drawable[] {...} `to Add(...)  and `AddRange(new Drawable[] {...}` in order to  not overwrite the component responsible for the hover sound.
Do you think I should go ahead with implementing this solution?
That solution is already described in this issue thread, yes.

I found a more amicable solution. How about adding:
```csharp
public override bool ReceivePositionalInputAt(Vector2 screenSpacePos) => Parent?.ReceivePositionalInputAt(screenSpacePos) ?? false;
```
to `HoverSampleDebounceComponent` (the base class of `Hover{Click}Sounds`)? There is one precedent with using `Parent` here:
https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/7bc8908ca9c026fed1d831eb6e58df7624a8d614/osu.Game/Rulesets/Edit/PlacementBlueprint.cs#L124

I could also refactor the base class to inherit `Component` instead of `CompositeDrawable` and effectively make it a `0x0` drawable (if that improves anything).

---

Removing `good-first-issue` and assigning myself for now.

Given what the component is doing, that may be a good solution.

Not so sure about making them `0x0` size though.
